Discover Gunung Leuser

Explore the wild heart of Sumatra, walk through the rainforest, discover incredible wildlife, and experience an unforgettable jungle adventure.

Start Your Adventure

Into the Wild

Experience the beauty of the rainforest and discover one of Sumatra's most remarkable natural environments.

Meet the Wildlife

Gunung Leuser is home to incredible rainforest wildlife, including the Sumatran orangutan.


During your trek, you can experience the rainforest, discover local wildlife, and enjoy the peaceful atmosphere of the jungle.

We always go with a licensed tour guide who is authorized to bring international tourists.

Trekking Experience

Experience the rainforest, wildlife, local food and beautiful landscapes during your journey.

🌿 1 Day Package

A short jungle adventure for visitors who want to experience the rainforest and wildlife.

🏕️ 2 Days 1 Night

Spend more time exploring the jungle and enjoying the rainforest experience.

🌳 3 Days 2 Nights

A longer adventure with more time to explore, experience the jungle and enjoy the journey.

We currently offer trekking packages from 1 to 3 days. If you would like to know the price or get more information, please contact us through the WhatsApp number below.

🚣

River Rafting Adventure

Your adventure doesn't end when the trekking ends. On the last day of the trip, we include a river rafting experience as part of the journey back.


Enjoy the river, the surrounding rainforest and an exciting way to finish your Gunung Leuser adventure.
